page.notes: The "10" at the top left corner is pencilled handwriting and was not transcribed. The printed "16.——Sex" is the last line, with the number 16 and the start of the next item, so it is transcribed as a list line and not as a catchword. "An" in the line "Dubium Primum. An fit Legum" is struck through in print. "Dubium Primum" in the second list is also struck through in print, and the "Legis promulgatæ" line is partly italic. Italic boundaries are approximate. The "De Lege Pœnali." line is set in larger type and is treated as a level-2 subtitle, not a list line. The large initial "F" of FINIS is joined to the word. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
